invariants.rationale: The method returns a Map<K, V> created via Collectors.toMap so result is always non-null.
Each element of data maps to at most one key in result; duplicate keys are resolved so the Map can't have more keys than input elements.
parallelism is given as Integer in the parameter list and is expected to be non-null at exit.
func is used to generate pairs for the result. It must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
data is used as the input collection; null would cause a NullPointerException.
